pages.text: $(thing)FirmaLife HardCore$() has rewritten the greenhouse system. $(l)No Climate Station needed$() — detection is automatic.$(br2)The key to a greenhouse is the $(l)glass roof$(). An enclosed space is recognized as a greenhouse when its roof has at least $(thing)50%$() glass blocks. Glass must have a $(l)clear view of the sky$() to count.

pages.title: Temperature Calculation
pages.text: Greenhouse Base Temp = 4°C + $(thing)40 × Canopy Ratio$().$(br2)Example: 100% glass roof → 44°C base. 50% glass roof → 24°C base.$(br2)Effective Temp = Base + (Outdoor − Base) × (1 − Average Resistance).$(br2)Wall resistance still matters — use high-resistance blocks for greenhouse walls to maintain warmth.

pages.title: Building Tips
pages.text: $(li)Horizontal span ≤ 15 blocks, vertical ≤ 5 blocks.$()$(br)$(li)Greenhouse-specific blocks (Treated Wood, Copper, Iron, Stainless Steel) work, but regular blocks in the resistance tiers also work.$()$(br)$(li)Floors may be non-air blocks.$()$(br)$(li)Place $(l:firmalife/planters)Planters$() inside for year-round crop growth.$()
